story.originalTitle: F1 Dutch GP: Antonelli pips Norris in practice amid poor showing for Red Bull
story.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli topped the sole practice session for the Dutch Grand Prix with a 1m12.949s lap, the only driver to dip below 1m13s, while McLaren's Lando Norris was second on 1m13.070s. Red Bull had a poor session, with Max Verstappen 11th and Liam Lawson 14th.
detailZh: F1荷兰大奖赛：红牛表现不佳，安东内利在练习赛中力压诺里斯
F1锦标赛领头羊在夏休期后回归的荷兰大奖赛唯一一节练习赛中排名第一
基米·安东内利在荷兰大奖赛练习赛中跑出最快圈速，这位锦标赛领头羊在F1夏休期结束后延续了此前的状态。
这位梅赛德斯明星在赞德福特赛道跑出1分12秒949的单圈，是唯一跑进1分13秒以内的车手，第二名是迈凯伦的卫冕世界冠军兰多·诺里斯，成绩为1分13秒070。
车手们迅速驶出维修区参加这个冲刺周末的唯一一节练习赛——这也是赞德福特赛道向F1告别的时刻——在潮湿的海滨赛道上，中性胎是初始选择。
但赛道条件正在变干，尼科·霍肯伯格几乎立刻表示“我觉得该用干胎了”，因此很快就放弃了中性胎，奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在五分钟后就换上了中性胎。
这位迈凯伦车手以1分23秒311的成绩领跑，比使用中性胎最快的刘易斯·汉密尔顿快2.251秒，随后在下一圈将成绩提升至1分20秒480。
这种剧烈的提升预示着不断演变的赛道上将有更多变化，安东内利在最初三圈中先后跑出1分18秒264、1分16秒112和1分15秒531，飙升至榜首。
因此圈速不断下降，汉密尔顿、乔治·拉塞尔和夏尔·勒克莱尔都曾登上榜首，而安东内利在一小时练习赛进行到一半时也在10号弯经历了360度打转。“我不知道那里到底发生了什么，”这位梅赛德斯车手报告说。
当剩余10分钟软胎测试开始时，一切自然升级，皮亚斯特里率先以1分13秒608打破了勒克莱尔的中性胎标杆成绩（1分14秒146）。
不过皮亚斯特里没有领先太久，勒克莱尔以0.261秒的优势重新夺回榜首，随后法拉利队友汉密尔顿跑出1分13秒139，比他快0.208秒。
但在最后五分钟，赛道上依然变化不断，诺里斯以1分13秒105跑出最快，随后被安东内利以0.156秒的优势超越。
这对锦标赛领头羊来说已经足够，他以50分的优势领先第二名汉密尔顿，并保持榜首位置，因为诺里斯在最后一圈未能提升成绩。
不过第三名在最后时刻发生变化，安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔——落后这位意大利车手59分——跑出1分13秒074，比第四名的汉密尔顿快0.065秒。
勒克莱尔以落后0.289秒的成绩位列前五，而第六名的皮亚斯特里差距较大，这位澳大利亚车手的1分13秒608使他落后安东内利0.659秒。
因此前三支车队——梅赛德斯、法拉利和迈凯伦——照常占据了前六名，而第七名属于奥迪的霍肯伯格，他令人印象深刻地在后期用中性胎跑出1分13秒784。
队友加布里埃尔·博托莱托采取了类似策略，后期跑出1分13秒992，最终排名第九，阿尔派的皮埃尔·加斯利以1分13秒911的硬胎成绩夹在两人之间。
小红牛新秀阿尔维德·林德布拉德（1分14秒285）跻身前十，这对红牛来说是一节糟糕的练习赛，马克斯·维斯塔潘和伊萨克·哈贾尔的替补利亚姆·劳森分别位列第11和第14。
这位四届世界冠军于周四宣布续约，他报告了降挡和转向过度的问题，并在进入最后一个弯道时冲出赛道。
冲刺排位赛将于周五下午进行。
detailEn: F1 Dutch GP: Antonelli pips Norris in practice amid poor showing for Red Bull
The F1 championship leader topped the sole practice session upon returning from the summer break at the Dutch GP
Kimi Antonelli was fastest in practice for the Dutch Grand Prix as the championship leader picked up where he left off upon Formula 1’s return from its summer break.
The Mercedes star set a 1m12.949s lap at Zandvoort and was the only driver to go sub-1m13s as second-place went to McLaren’s reigning world champion Lando Norris with a 1m13.070s.
Drivers were quick to head out for the sole practice session of this sprint weekend - one where Zandvoort bids farewell to F1 - with intermediates the initial choice on a damp seaside track.
But conditions were drying, Nico Hulkenberg saying “I think it’s slicks” almost instantly, so it didn’t take long to ditch the intermediates with Oscar Piastri using mediums five minutes in.
The McLaren driver set the pace on a 1m23.311s, 2.251s quicker than Lewis Hamilton who was fastest on intermediates, before reducing that to a 1m20.480s with his next lap.
That drastic improvement was a sign of things to come on the evolving surface as Antonelli surged to the top with a 1m18.264s, 1m16.112s and then a 1m15.531s on his opening three tours.

So the lap times kept tumbling, Hamilton, George Russell and Charles Leclerc all greeted the top of the leaderboard, while Antonelli also endured a 360-degree spin at Turn 10 halfway through the one-hour session. “I don’t know what the heck happened there,” reported the Mercedes driver.
Everything naturally ramped up when the soft tyre runs commenced with 10 minutes remaining and Piastri was first to beat Leclerc’s medium benchmark (1m14.146s) by setting a 1m13.608s.
Piastri wasn’t fastest for long though as Leclerc regained top spot by 0.261s, before a 1m13.139s lap for Ferrari team-mate Hamilton put him 0.208s quicker.
But there was yet more change in the final five minutes on a busy circuit as Norris went quickest with a 1m13.105s, subsequently beaten by Antonelli who was 0.156s faster.
That was enough for the championship leader, who holds a 50-point advantage over runner-up Hamilton, to remain top as Norris failed to improve on his final lap.
There was a late change for third though, as Antonelli’s team-mate George Russell - who is 59 points behind the Italian - set a 1m13.074s to go 0.065s quicker than fourth-placed Hamilton.
Leclerc rounded out the top five with a lap that was 0.289s off the pace and it was a big gap to Piastri in sixth as the Australian’s 1m13.608s put him 0.659s behind Antonelli.
So the top three teams - Mercedes, Ferrari and McLaren - occupied the first six spots as usual, whereas seventh went to Audi’s Hulkenberg who impressively set a 1m13.784s with the mediums late on.
Team-mate Gabriel Bortoleto opted for a similar strategy with a 1m13.992s late on and he finished ninth, with Alpine’s Pierre Gasly splitting the pair after setting a 1m13.911s on hards.
Racing Bulls rookie Arvid Lindblad (1m14.285s) completed the top 10 in a poor session for Red Bull, who respectively finished 11th and 14th via Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar’s stand-in Liam Lawson.
The four-time world champion, who on Thursday announced his contract renewal, reported problems with downshifts and oversteer and had an off heading into the final corner.
Sprint qualifying is up next on Friday afternoon.

detailZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿的巴西大奖赛帽子揭幕，发布日期确认
法拉利为刘易斯·汉密尔顿揭幕了一款特别的巴西主题帽子，他将佩戴这款帽子参加2026年的巴西大奖赛
法拉利车迷们。最新的法拉利F1车队新闻，车手更新，技术分析和来自马拉内洛及更远地方的赛事反应
法拉利揭幕了一款巴西主题帽子，刘易斯·汉密尔顿将在巴西大奖赛中佩戴，粉丝们可以在比赛前几天购买自己的帽子。
Maranello车队与Puma在10月16日通过Instagram联合发布了这款帽子。"莱维斯将在Interlagos赛道上戴上带着一小块巴西元素的帽子。而且它很快也将属于你。将于11月3日开始发售，"车队在展示七届冠军戴着新设计的帽子的照片时写道。
这款帽子以大胆的黄色为主题，细节处有磨损效果，露出下面的绿色，反映了巴西国旗的颜色。法拉利标志以银色突出地放置在前面，与银色的Puma标志相匹配，缝制在帽檐右侧。
"给我来一顶吧，莱维斯先生，"一位粉丝评论道，另一位粉丝补充说："我甚至不是法拉利的粉丝，但这真的很酷。我也想戴。"
其他人质疑这款帽子是否是法拉利车手将在Interlagos赛事中引入类似特殊头盔的信号。
汉密尔顿于2022年11月正式成为巴西的荣誉公民。
"我想对在这里的每一个人说声大大的谢谢，对于那些为了让这一天成为可能而搬山填海的人，" 41岁的汉密尔顿当时说。"这对我来说真的是一种巨大的荣誉，能够在这里接受和接受这个公民身份。我真的感觉现在我是你们中的一员，终于。
"当我2007年第一次来到这里[汉密尔顿的第一个F1赛季]，这里的爱是如何增长的，我们共同的经历，尤其是2021年[他向胜利发起冲击]，知道你们一直在我身后为我加油，这是我一生中最特别的时刻之一。我迫不及待地想要继续努力向前。
"我真的很想将今天，这个荣誉，献给埃尔顿·塞纳——献给埃尔顿的家庭，他的朋友和他的粉丝。对我来说，当我五岁的时候，我第一次看到埃尔顿赛车，那就是我知道我想要成为世界冠军，就像他一样。
“那时我才知道并了解了巴西。那时我开始以巴西队的身份玩FIFA！但实际上，通过他的眼睛，我看到了巴西人有多么热情，这种热爱和激情有多深，你对国家的热爱有多么美好。我非常兴奋能在这里多待一些时间。”
2026年巴西大奖赛将于11月6日至8日举行，这将是一个三连赛的一部分，从10月23日至25日的美国大奖赛开始，接着是10月30日至11月1日的墨西哥大奖赛。
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton's Brazilian GP cap unveiled with release date confirmed
Ferrari has unveiled a special Brazil-themed cap for Lewis Hamilton to wear at the 2026 Brazilian Grand Prix
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.
Ferrari has revealed a Brazil-themed cap that Lewis Hamilton will wear at the Brazilian Grand Prix, and fans will be able to buy their own a few days before the race.

The Maranello outfit announced the cap in a joint Instagram post with Puma on 16 October. "Lewis will be wearing a small piece of Brazil with him at Interlagos. And it can also be yours soon. Available to buy on November 3rd," the team wrote alongside photos of the seven-time champion wearing the new design.

The cap features a bold yellow theme with distressed detailing that reveals green underneath, reflecting the colours of the Brazilian flag. The Ferrari logo is prominently placed on the front in silver, with a matching silver Puma logo embroidered on the front right of the bill.
"Give me one right now, Sir Lewis Hamilton," one fan commented, while another added: "I'm not even a Ferrari fan, but that is slick. I'd wear it."
Others questioned whether the cap could be a sign that the Ferrari driver will introduce a similar special helmet for the race at Interlagos.
Hamilton officially became an honorary citizen of Brazil in November 2022.

"I’d like to say a big, big thank you to everyone here at the house, for all those who’ve moved mountains to make this day possible," the 41-year-old said at the time. "It is honestly the greatest honour for me to be here receiving and accepting this citizenship. I really do feel like now I’m one of you, finally.

"When I arrived here in 2007 [Hamilton’s first F1 season], the love that’s grown, the experiences we’ve had and, particularly 2021 [his charge to victory], knowing you guys were cheering me on the way, it was one of the most special moments of my entire life. I can’t wait for us to continue to strive ahead.

"I really want to dedicate today, this honour, to Ayrton Senna – to Ayrton’s family, to his friends and to his fans. For me, when I was five years old, I saw Ayrton race for the first time, and that was the moment I knew that I wanted to be a world champion, just like him.

"It was then that I knew and learnt about Brazil. It was then that I started to play FIFA as Brazil! But really, through his eyes, I was able to see how passionate Brazilians were, and how deep it goes, the love and passion you have for your country, and how beautiful it is. I’m so excited to spend some more time here."

The 2026 Brazilian Grand Prix is scheduled for 6-8 November and will round out a triple-header starting with the United States Grand Prix from 23-25 October followed by the Mexican Grand Prix from 30 October to 1 November.
